scope: 4 seasons x dawn/dusk/night lighting variants and cloud/fog/wind transparent overlays
source_policy: Each lighting asset directly edits its corresponding122day native; no generated123asset is a reference for another asset. Weather inputs guide texture only. Existing122day/rain/snow assets, furniture, sofa and character sources remain unchanged.
prompt_policy: Actual prompt text is preserved verbatim; absolute reference locations and operational identifiers are replaced by repo-relative public source lineage.
original_vs_derivative: generation.original is the unaltered model-call PNG. final is a separately retained512x384 production PNG. runtime is its WebP encoding. Scene lighting is part of the generated pixels, not a recoloring derivative.

generation.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the attached daytime landscape into the requested time of day. It is the direct edit target, not merely a loose style example. Preserve exactly the same viewpoint, 4:3 framing, horizon, cottage placement, wooden bridge shape and railings, stone path, stream bend, boulders, tree trunks and branch arrangement. Preserve the existing season and natural hand-painted material realism. Repaint actual sky, directional illumination, surface shading and water reflections coherently across the scene; a flat tint or exposure filter is insufficient. Keep the existing pale pink blossoms, tender spring leaves and fresh meadow flowers. Dawn / actual sunrise: repaint a pale lavender-blue sky graduating to a restrained peach-gold horizon; a small low rising sun partly hidden behind the existing distant ridge. Warm first light touches the cottage roof, branch edges, bridge rail and stones while foreground shade remains cool. Paint matching soft sunrise reflections in the existing water. Fresh quiet morning, clearly earlier and cooler than sunset. Full-bleed opaque horizontal 4:3 landscape, one image only. No window frame, room, furniture, characters, pets, text, logos or UI. No moved buildings or bridge, new objects, season change, baked-in falling rain or snow, fog overlay, decorative symbols or collage.

derivation.operation: Preserve model output bytes; center crop to exact4:3 if necessary, then uniform Lanczos downscale only. No recolor, filter, repaint or matte replacement.
